5. **Turn on Airplane Mode (when possible):** If you’re not using Wi-Fi or data for the call, airplane mode can help—but if you need a connection, just make sure you’re not running other wireless features like Bluetooth unnecessarily.

7. **Update Apps & OS:** Sometimes, crashes and overheating are caused by buggy software. Make sure your phone and your calling app are up to date.
